## Important
- app/display.py:14 — correctness — For revision `0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef01234567`, status displays `0123456`, while history and completion display `0123456789ab`, contradicting the documented promise to use the same identifier. Use `revision[:12]` consistently. — Deployments whose revisions share seven leading characters become indistinguishable in status despite being distinguishable in history.
